title: about 12 hours with astra 6.2, have the bones of my dream game.
author: Strong-Detective-513
selftext: only have the $20 plan and a dream, this is where im sitting at after about 3 five hour cycles today, its mostly a asset and menu creator as is, seeing what i can set up and how i can use it, GODOT engine, has a astronomical ways to go, but this is the foundation. using only 6.2 to build this, while building assets with the help of free chat, 6.2 is honestly phenomenal at token usage, made way more progress then ive expected. no real clue what its gonna be yet besides a old school party combat game yet, but heres to a dream!
